name: Developer
description: Space-dark developer portfolio with a real 3D keyboard floating in a star-field — thin gradient display type, blur-in reveals, a timeline of experience, screenshot project cards with a detail modal, an elastic cursor, and buttery smooth scroll.
designNotes: The Developer template — 'Spacebar' — reimagines an engineer's portfolio as a moment in deep space: a real 3D mechanical keyboard (a Spline scene embedded via the <spline-viewer> web component) floats and slowly rotates on scroll behind a mouse-parallax canvas star-field, on a near-black navy field lit by a single violet glow and a sky-blue counter-glow. Archivo Black carries the huge thin gradient hero name and section titles; Inter sets the prose; JetBrains Mono is reserved for eyebrows, dates and the loading readout. Content arrives through a preloader (simulated progress + slide-up reveal) and then blur-in / box-reveal scroll animations. The Tech Stack section renders the portfolio owner's skills as pressable keycaps (Font Awesome brand glyphs or a mono abbreviation, colour-cycled per category) echoing the live keyboard behind them. Experience is a rail-and-node timeline of cards; projects are screenshot cards that open a detail modal with metrics, tech badges, a gallery and links. A floating pill nav with scrollspy and an elastic, velocity-stretched cursor complete the feel. Everything degrades gracefully: a blocked Spline/Lenis CDN, reduced-motion, or touch devices fall back to the star-field and native scroll, and a hard timeout guarantees the preloader never traps the page. The 3D scene URL is overridable via customization.skillsSplineUrl. Design language adapted from Naresh Khatri's open-source 3D portfolio, credited in the footer.
